assumptions: Real-camera association and self-routing policy (authored, uncalibrated; applies only when camera observations are enabled): strict projected point-in-box matches take precedence; when those miss, unused pre-delivery camera-only local tracks may associate if their ground estimate lies within the measured bottom-edge half-span (maximum distance from its bottom-centre ground estimate to either calibrated bottom-corner ground intersection) around the current box bottom-centre ground estimate, derived from current pixels, calibration and ground prior rather than a fixed metric radius. Newly created tracks in this delivery are ineligible for this fallback. One-person-per-frame used_people exclusion and existing projected-centre distance ranking remain binding; association is not confirmed identity or needs. A corroborated priority-81 camera T027 proposed by its own capable agent may self-route over a lower-priority local commitment through the same acceptance checks and normal A053/A056/A053 action-boundary checkpoint, with A057 revalidation on resume; an in-flight physical action is not instantly interrupted. Non-interruptibility, queued/in-flight ordinary A052/A053/A056/A057/A058 controls, pending assignments and assigned/received local tasks remain reserved. No truth, urgency threshold, installed capability, scene geometry, capacity or receiver check is changed; contact, rescue and fixed-horizon results are not guaranteed.

Shared camera allocation/contact policy (authored, uncalibrated; not catalog urgency): all scenes use T002=70, T014=70 (80 for locally believed major/destroyed damage), and established-human T027=78. A single-frame camera-candidate T027 stays <=64; person/human detections of the same locally associated candidate in >=2 distinct capture parent /image IDs from the same reporting agent promote its T027 to 81, above those surveys at a safe boundary. Raw/associated copies, duplicate boxes and replays of the same capture count once. An existing waiting proposed T027 is refreshed in-place once on promotion, without a new A050 or revision; timestamps and frame IDs are not proposal-signature changes. Camera-review T011 stays <=63. Failed candidate A009 sensor contacts suppress the same candidate or a locally recorded site within 3 m for 120 s and require camera presence evidence acquired after the failure before retry; failure does not establish human absence. These are shared defaults even without camera_search_policy; explicit existing overrides are honored, and regional search policies are unchanged. Existing commitments use authored policy fields F202/F209/F212 from 10_字段385; 05_任务96 and 14_场景任务映射 do not mandate task ordering. A coordinator-known accepted/executing commitment with a matching delivered current-task id/revision remains an allocator candidate, subject to priority, interruptibility, capability, access, payload and energy checks. Queued A052 and assignments awaiting delivery/acceptance remain reserved; unmatched current-task reports do not release them. A053 acceptance-to-deadline windows are not unconditional uninterruptible leases: replacement acceptance still waits for the real action boundary and A056 checkpoint, with A057 revalidation on resume. Equal-priority 81 contacts cannot interrupt each other. A queued camera T027 is canceled as stale through A054 only when its exact local candidate has a delivered belief.entity_ref and the referenced human needs are known without a contact need. Recheck before allocation/acceptance and before initial approach/A009, not after this task own successful contact; no distance-only identity or suppression of unassociated tracks. A059 services may preempt only a lower-priority executing preemptible ordinary commitment through the existing A053/A056 action-boundary checkpoint and A057 resume; active service scopes and real capability/access/energy/aboard constraints remain binding. Service A053 rechecks local commitments, and refusals retain busy/payload/access/energy/tool causes instead of all becoming capability failures. Fresh unassociated tracks can still starve lower-priority searches under this unchanged policy. No scene switch, truth, count, location, outcome or capability change is introduced. Survey-relative starvation is expected to be removed only when corroboration and real capability, access, energy and delivery permit; contact, rescue and fixed-horizon results are not guaranteed.

Camera re-sightings of an already contacted person (a local non-camera human with delivered contact needs) associate to that person when strict point-in-box and camera-track matches miss, using the same measured box tests: its contact foot point projected inside the box, else within the measured bottom-edge half-span around the box bottom-centre ground estimate. One-person-per-frame exclusion still applies. This prevents repeat contacts of the same known resident from minting new tracks; it never marks an uncontacted or unknown person absent and changes no truth, needs, urgency or capability.

A carrier with an unacknowledged person aboard does not accept (A053) or resume (A057) unrelated work such as contact, survey or clearance until that person is handed over; care, load, transport, handover and water-recovery tasks (T029-T036) still proceed. This applies the existing A059 service rule ("a team with a person aboard finishes that person's handover before serving anyone else") to ordinary tasks. A deferred commitment stays suspended, not failed; capacity, access, receiver and truth checks are unchanged.

Camera-only search policy (authored, uncalibrated; not additional catalog rules): Q009 permits budgeted re-search and preserves uncertainty after misses. The coordinator may schedule another completed-camera T009 pass after 60 s until until_s, changing the public-map lane pass index; an image/task completion alone is not regional coverage. A locally reported belief.search_status=complete stops repeats; unknown/partial/inconclusive remains eligible. Explicit delivered mission/search closure or satisfied public find_person records stop repeats; hidden evaluator goals are never policy inputs. Failed candidate A009 sensor contacts suppress the same candidate or a locally recorded site within 3 m for 120 s and require camera evidence acquired after the failure before retry. No failure establishes human absence; all capability, energy, hazard and action checks remain authoritative. SC12 uses the established 18 m public polygon lane spacing at its unchanged 12 m UAV AGL instead of centroid-only visits. Scripted-only passes and SC01 retain their existing policy.

T001/T009 fly clipped parallel lanes over public mapped polygons instead of visiting only their centroids. Lane spacing is an authored search policy, not detection or coverage evidence; captures, inference, hazards, energy, contacts and action results remain authoritative. No casualty truth enters the route.
v0.5 scripted sensing/network/compute; no vision, ns-3, calibrated rescue physics or buoyancy model. Existing SC03 flood profile and its 480 s water_rise event are retained.

Two intact D0 buildings with no authored interior casualties occupy GLB dry_placement plots; building.flood_exposure and road.water_depth_m are derived by the existing core hazard. No flooded building or road blockage is invented on the high west terrace.

The stage-1.50 water polygon follows both layout waterline polylines in their supplied order and closes only along the north/south background boundary. Water is a core water entity, not a dry plot. The full canonical class names and the vehicle approach classes are configured for SC03.

One authored outdoor person starts in the selected RESV_LOW_S_SUBMERGED or RESV_LOW_N_SUBMERGED metadata reservation, inside the water polygon on FLOODPLAIN_LOW, with whole-footprint depth 0.35-0.75 m. The deep RIVER_CHANNEL is excluded. Mobility limited, no buriedness or injury, and transport need are initial conditions; no detection or action outcome is pinned.

NEW-HUM-W01 FLOATING includes its NEW-FLT-001 flotation ring and fitted life jacket. It is one person display, not a second casualty or a new delivered-supply receipt. The display follows human.location_context=water until actual recovery; carried geometry is represented by NEW-BOAT-001-C01 LOADED.

Two core boat embodiments use the produced 4.95 x 2.034 m rescue boat at unit scale, with inherited 500 kg payload. They launch afloat on the west bank near the shared road-accessible landing, within source water and configured 0.50-1.0 m footprint depth. These are authored abstract navigation thresholds, not a draught certification: the asset has a permanently lowered motor with nominal 0.72 m clearance, which this existing core does not model; no physical propeller clearance is claimed for shallow floodplain travel.

The shoreline receiving point is an abstract staffed medical station on dry EMBANKMENT_FILL, with its real medical_point footprint, finite capacity 2 and explicit receiver confirmation. Its authored 3 m dry approach connects to MAIN_ROAD_NS and stays at least 0.15 m above the stage datum. Public catalog station.access_region (F150) is the water-side boat berth, at most 20 m from the dry receiver. A021 approaches this berth and A022 still checks actual distance, capacity and confirmation; boat navigation never targets the dry tent. On confirmed A022, the staffed receiver transfers the person to its dry station pose within the existing 20 m handover envelope; this is an authored abstract shore transfer, not a simulated gangway or walking animation.

A separate medical-1 with capacity 4 occupies a dry source plot, reachable through its SPUR access and distinct from building-1. The command post, ambulance, team and UAV starts are sampled off the carriageway on allowed dry classes near the shoreline operation. The existing foot team has its inherited catalog carrying capacity and equipment; no water capability is added to it or to the ambulance.

Task allowlists limit the compact search/locate/water recovery/transport/handover mission. Q036 uses A003 to approach the observed person, A023 to recover aboard, A021 to the shore berth, A022 to confirm reception and A036 to report. Tasks and assignments still require local beliefs, messages, installed capabilities and resources.

The core SC03 hazard models an authored 0.25 m water-depth rise at 480 s on its fixed hazard footprint. It does not recompute a new shoreline, stage mesh or buoyant elevation; displayed afloat assets use source datum U=1.50 m. This distinguishes the existing abstract event from a simulated moving free surface.

Search misses, wrong/uncertain observations, action failures, unassigned tasks and unfinished objectives remain visible. Speeds, sensing probabilities, durations, work rates and staffed receiver behaviour are inherited or authored uncalibrated assumptions.
Generated instance presence is not task completion; existing agent capabilities, beliefs, execution, logs and AAS plugin remain authoritative.

Compatibility authority: configs/asset_allocation.json scenes.SC03.rules. Mission provenance records explicit delivered-BASE human substitutions; missing assets are not fetched or credited as delivered variants.
Camera observation settings reuse SC01; task allowlists/capabilities remain scene-specific. Missing generated incident subjects or exact staffed facilities refuse explicitly.
